FRN.formula: FRN_N2_offer_s ~ abs_rpe_s + abs_epe_valence_s + abs_epe_arousal_s +      P2_offer_s + P2_base_offer_s + (1 + abs_epe_arousal_s + P2_offer_s +      P2_base_offer_s | sub)

P3a.formula: P3a_offer_s ~ abs_rpe_s + abs_epe_valence_s + abs_epe_arousal_s +      P3a_base_offer_s + (1 + abs_rpe_s + abs_epe_arousal_s + P3a_base_offer_s |      sub)

P3b.formula: P3b_offer_s ~ abs_rpe_s + abs_epe_valence_s + abs_epe_arousal_s +      P3b_base_offer_s + (1 + abs_rpe_s + P3b_base_offer_s | sub)

estimator: REML for the disclosed fixed/random-effects model; optimizer implementation and language are not exact-match criteria.
preprocessing: Unchanged source-scaled columns; source-row positional ERP/behavior correspondence is assumed, not independently established.

primary.name: equal_model_coefficient_RMSE_in_reference_SE
primary.definition: Mean over the three models of sqrt(mean over its fixed effects of ((submitted beta - reference beta)/reference SE)^2).

secondary: For each model: RMS over unique upper-triangle entries including the diagonal of (submitted covariance - reference covariance) divided by the corresponding product of reference coefficient SEs. The lower triangle is excluded from this discrepancy metric; full matrix symmetry and positive-definiteness remain separate validity checks.
independently reconstructed P3b valence-minus-reward estimate/SE/z/two-sided normal p from submitted coefficients and full covariance
candidate-reported versus independently reconstructed contrast quantities
report_policy: Bounded interpretation prose retained but unscored; numerical factual checks are not scientific-reasoning qualification.
unsupported_analysis_family: needs_adjudication before loading private numerical reference; no exact-source failure assigned to a warranted alternative model.
no_claims: input-dependent program execution from submitted summary alone

arithmetic_diagnostics.positive_definite_check: Small-matrix Cholesky on symmetrized entries for this diagnostic only; discrepancy metric uses original entries.
arithmetic_diagnostics.source: Prospective numerical arithmetic tolerances, to qualify with generated/known summaries; not significance or scientific-success thresholds.

row_selection.alignment: Append all eight tables by the published source row order; ERP exports lack independent trial identifiers.

row_selection.participant: Treat sub as a categorical participant identifier.
row_selection.per_model: Retain complete cases over every variable in the disclosed formula, including outcome, fixed effects, random effects and sub; require all retained numeric fields finite.
row_selection.scaled_columns: Use the published scaled columns unchanged.
